title: endue item v0: agent sessions
description: The fields of a record item whose schema is this document's $id: one session of an agent program on this computer (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes), as the built-in connector desk.agent-sessions reads it from the program's own transcripts, read-only (ADR 0403). The item's body holds what the person asked and the last answer, secrets masked; tool output and reasoning are never kept.

AgentProgram.description: The program that ran the session.

AgentSessionFields.description: One session: who ran it, where, and the things it touched (its links).

sessionId.description: The program's own id for the session.

parent.description: The item id of the session that started this one, for a subagent.

subagent.description: Whether another session started this one.

file.description: The transcript the session was read from, ~ for the home folder.

cwd.description: The folder the session worked in, ~ for the home folder.

repo.description: cwd with a .claude/worktrees/<name> or .worktrees/<name> folder folded away, so every worktree of a repository is one.

turns.description: The prompts the person wrote, injected context left out.

tools.description: The most used tools by name, with how often each was called (20 at most).

mcp.description: The MCP servers whose tools the session called.

domains.description: Hosts of the URLs in the prompts, answers and commands (30 at most).

AgentSessionLink.description: One thing the session touched, the knowledge base's edge from the session to it.

key.description: Stable across sessions: a file's path (~ for home, worktrees folded), a ticket key (ACME-868), a pull request as host/path#number, an ADR as ADR-0088@repo, a branch as repo@branch, a repository's folder.

AgentLinkRel.description: edited and read: a tool changed or read the file; wrote: a memory note; mentioned: named in text; opened: the session opened the pull request; cites: an ADR named or opened; on: the branch the session ran on; in: the repository it ran in.

AgentLinkPlace.description: Where a mention was found: the person's prompt, an answer, a tool call's input, the branch name.
